target_customer: B2B sales and revenue teams, mostly startups and SMB software companies
problem: Sales teams waste effort on cold outbound; Avina finds in-market prospects through buying signals and automates warm outreach.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription, pricing from 149 dollars a month per the launch post
product_category: Sales intelligence and AI outbound agents

founders.name: Vivek Sudarsan
previous_startups: Bowtie, AI receptionist sold to Mindbody
founders.background_notes: YC page bio; Mindbody press release confirms the Bowtie.ai acquisition in May 2019 but does not name him.

founders.name: Mike Wang
previous_startups: Bowtie, AI receptionist sold to Mindbody

competitors.name: Common Room
competitors.what: Customer and community intelligence platform capturing buying signals
competitors.funding_then: About 52 to 53 million dollars total per aggregators, timing not stated

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating web and third party signals and sending outreach is integration heavy but relies on existing data providers and LLMs.

defensibility.rationale: Signal and outreach tools are easy to copy and many rivals (Unify, Clay, Apollo, ZoomInfo) overlap.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Avina's own comparison pages list ZoomInfo, 6sense, Clearbit, Salesloft and others as alternatives; Unify raised a 40 million dollar Series B in July 2025.

market_need_then: Warm outbound over cold outreach; evidence is mainly the company's own claims and its 2024 seed. Intent signal category was already an active market with Common Room founded in 2020.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and benefit led: stop chasing cold leads, start closing warm ones

branding.brand_signature: X-ray vision for your sales team positioning
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch in April 2026 reached number 5 for the day with 212 upvotes and was hunted by Garry Tan (per search summary).

brand_strength.rationale: Some Product Hunt traction and customer logos, but several unrelated Avina products share the name and no independent brand coverage.

pivots.from: X-ray vision for your sales team (earlier launch)
pivots.to: GTM agents for signals, qualification and outbound
pivots.why: YC page lists both launch titles; reason and date not stated

outcome_analysis: Avina is a small sales signals company from founders who previously sold Bowtie to Mindbody. It raised a 3.2 million dollar seed in October 2024 led by nvp capital and RRE, relaunched as AI agents in 2026 and claims hundreds of B2B sales team customers. It competes in a crowded signals market with well funded rivals, so the future depends on whether warm outbound agents can beat larger platforms.
notes: Seed 3.2 million dollars cross-checked by FinSMEs and Cornell Tech. A 500 thousand dollar pre-seed in 2022 and totals of 3.6 to 6.8 million appear on aggregators only and are unverified. Competitor entry for Common Room is flagged: its source is dated 2025 and the company was founded in 2020; the Unify rival was founded in 2023 so is excluded. The Bowtie link to Avina founders rests on the YC page; the Mindbody release names a different CEO (Ron Fisher) and does not name them. Founder education not found.
